corrections.defect: `MATCH (x:$($label) {uid: $uid})`: a dynamic label cannot use a label/uid index on 5.26, so the planner scans all nodes
corrections.fix: one uid seek per stored label family (Entity plus the 12 labels without Entity) in a UNION subquery, label kept as a predicate (`WHERE $label IN labels(x)`): every branch uses a uid constraint
corrections.statement:
// @id CQ-AX-04
// @param label:string
// @param absencePredicates:strings
CALL {
  MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Activity {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Adjudication {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Assertion {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Assessment {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Association {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:CaptureAttempt {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Chunk {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:MechanismEvidenceContext {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:Report {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:ReportItem {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:SourceLocator {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
  UNION
  MATCH (x:SourceSnapshot {uid: $uid}) WHERE $label IN labels(x) RETURN x
}
WITH x,
  EXISTS { (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.predicate = $predicate AND a.recordedTo IS NULL } AS hasAnswer,
  EXISTS { (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.predicate IN $absencePredicates AND a.polarity = 'POSITIVE' AND a.recordedTo IS NULL } AS measuredAbsent,
  COLLECT { MATCH (x)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(f:Assertion {predicate: 'FIELD_NOT_REPORTED'})
            WHERE f.valueString = $field AND f.recordedTo IS NULL RETURN f.uid } AS notReportedBy,
  COLLECT { MATCH (x)<-[:ASSESSES]-(act:Activity {activityKind: 'RESEARCH'}) RETURN act.uid } AS searchedBy,
  // R-09 / R-41: a CaptureAttempt (PARTIAL or FAILED) only ever means "blocked"; D11 property join on subjectUid
  COLLECT { MATCH (ca:CaptureAttempt {subjectUid: x.uid}) WHERE ca.outcome IN ['FAILED', 'PARTIAL']
            RETURN ca {.uid, .toolId, .outcome, .failureKind, .httpStatus, .attemptedAt} } AS blockedAttempts
RETURN x.uid AS subject, hasAnswer, measuredAbsent, notReportedBy, searchedBy, blockedAttempts,
       CASE WHEN hasAnswer THEN 'ANSWERED'
            WHEN measuredAbsent THEN 'MEASURED_ABSENT'
            WHEN size(notReportedBy) > 0 THEN 'NOT_REPORTED'
            WHEN size(blockedAttempts) > 0 THEN 'BLOCKED'
            WHEN size(searchedBy) > 0 THEN 'SEARCHED_NOTHING_FOUND'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS emptyAnswerKind

corrections.statement:
// @id Q-K-23
// @param label:string
CALL {
  MATCH (p:Entity {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Activity {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Adjudication {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Assertion {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Assessment {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Association {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:CaptureAttempt {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Chunk {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:MechanismEvidenceContext {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:Report {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:ReportItem {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:SourceLocator {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
  UNION
  MATCH (p:SourceSnapshot {uid: $asserterUid}) WHERE $label IN labels(p) RETURN p
}
CALL (p) {
  MATCH (o:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM'})-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(p)
  WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN o, 'ASSERTER' AS via, null AS work
  UNION
  // R-15 / R-80: claims stated in the voice of a Publication that P authored
  MATCH (au:Assertion {predicate: 'AUTHORED_BY'})-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(p)
  WHERE au.recordedTo IS NULL AND au.status <> 'REJECTED'
  MATCH (au)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(w:Publication)<-[:ASSERTED_BY]-(o:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM'})
  WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN o, 'AUTHORED_BY' AS via, w.uid AS work
  UNION
  // R-15: claims stated in the voice of a MediaWork that P authored (D9 APPEARS_IN {AUTHOR})
  MATCH (p)-[ap:APPEARS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)<-[:ASSERTED_BY]-(o:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM'})
  WHERE ap.appearanceRole = 'AUTHOR' AND ap.recordedTo IS NULL AND o.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN o, 'APPEARS_IN_AUTHOR' AS via, w.uid AS work
}
MATCH (o)-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]->(c:Claim)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:ASSESSES]-(r:Report {reportKind: 'EVIDENCE_REPORT'}) WHERE r.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:HAS_SUBJECT]-(rv:Assertion {predicate: 'RATES_CLAIM'})-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(reviewer)
WHERE rv.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH o, via, work, c, r,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rv IS NULL THEN null ELSE {reviewer: reviewer.name, rating: rv.valueString, ratingAssertion: rv.uid} END) AS ratings,
     coalesce(o.validFrom, o.validObservedAt) AS saidAt
RETURN c.uid AS claim, c.proposition AS proposition, o.uid AS occurrence, via, work, saidAt,
       r.uid AS report, r.verdict AS verdict, r.publishedAt AS reportPublishedAt, saidAt > r.publishedAt AS saidAfterReport, ratings
ORDER BY saidAt

corrections.defect: `MATCH (r) WHERE (r:Assertion OR r:Assessment OR r:Report) AND r.uid IN $answerInputUids`: label disjunction in WHERE plans an all-nodes scan
corrections.fix: seek each input uid per label in a UNION subquery (`uid_Assertion`, `uid_Assessment`, `uid_Report` constraints)
corrections.statement:
// @id CQ-RC-05
UNWIND $answerInputUids AS inputUid
CALL (inputUid) {
  MATCH (r:Assertion {uid: inputUid}) RETURN r
  UNION
  MATCH (r:Assessment {uid: inputUid}) RETURN r
  UNION
  MATCH (r:Report {uid: inputUid}) RETURN r
}
RETURN r.uid, CASE
  WHEN r:Assertion AND r.assertionKind = 'CLAIM' AND r.speechAct = 'RECOMMENDS' THEN 'SOURCE_RECOMMENDS'
  WHEN r:Assessment AND r.assessmentKind = 'EVIDENCE_SYNTHESIS' THEN 'EVIDENCE_FAVORS'
  WHEN r:Report AND r.reportKind = 'RECOMMENDATION' THEN 'BELLLABS_RECOMMENDS'
  ELSE 'OTHER' END AS provenanceKind,
  CASE WHEN r:Assessment THEN r.effectDirection END AS effectDirection,
  COLLECT { MATCH (r)-[tEv:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tLoc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tSnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tSrc:Source)
      WHERE tEv.role IN ['SUPPORTS', 'QUALIFIES']
      OPTIONAL MATCH (tSrc)-[:RENDITION_OF]->(tRw:MediaWork)
      RETURN {role: tEv.role, selectorKind: tLoc.selectorKind, exact: tLoc.exact, startOffset: tLoc.startOffset, endOffset: tLoc.endOffset,
              mediaStartSeconds: tLoc.mediaStartSeconds, mediaEndSeconds: tLoc.mediaEndSeconds, speakerLabel: tLoc.speakerLabelInSource,
              contentHash: tSnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tSnap.retrievedAt, captureCompleteness: tSnap.captureCompleteness,
              uri: tSrc.canonicalUri, genre: tSrc.genre, renditionOfWork: tRw.uid,
              captureFidelity: COLLECT { MATCH (tAdj:Adjudication {adjudicationKind: 'CAPTURE_FIDELITY'})-[:ASSESSES]->(r) WHERE tAdj.recordedTo IS NULL
                                         RETURN tAdj {.uid, .verdict, .policyOutcome} }} } AS trace

corrections.defect: the claim-condition subject `(cs)` is unlabelled inside `CALL (lv) { OPTIONAL MATCH (cond)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(cs) WHERE cs.uid IN ... }`, planned as an all-nodes scan
corrections.fix: label the subject `(cs:Entity)` (RegulatoryRecord and Claim both carry Entity) so the uid predicate seeks `entity_uid`
corrections.statement:
// @id Q-D12-18
// @param asOf:datetime
// @param validAt:datetime
// @param measurandUids:strings
// @param conditionSubjectUids:strings
MATCH (p:Product {uid: $productUid})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:ProductVariant)-[:HAS_PACKAGE]->(:Package)-[lve:HAS_LABEL_VERSION]->(lv:LabelVersion)
WHERE lve.recordedFrom <= $asOf AND (lve.recordedTo IS NULL OR lve.recordedTo > $asOf)
  AND ($validAt IS NULL OR ((lve.validFrom IS NULL OR lve.validFrom <= $validAt) AND (lve.validTo IS NULL OR lve.validTo > $validAt)))
MATCH (lv)-[dc:DECLARES_COMPONENT]->(c)                                        // D6 ComponentLineProperties: amount, unitCode, amountBasis
WHERE c.uid IN $measurandUids AND dc.recordedFrom <= $asOf AND (dc.recordedTo IS NULL OR dc.recordedTo > $asOf)
MATCH (decl:Assertion {uid: dc.assertionUid})                                  // R-30: the line's own Assertion holds the verbatim text
// the regulatory condition of the implied claim (D8 HAS_CLAIM_CONDITION, R-93; literal, subject RegulatoryRecord or kernel Claim)
CALL (lv) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (cond:Assertion {predicate: 'HAS_CLAIM_CONDITION'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(cs:Entity)
  WHERE cs.uid IN $conditionSubjectUids AND cond.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (cond.recordedTo IS NULL OR cond.recordedTo > $asOf)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cond IS NULL THEN null ELSE
           {condition: cond.uid, subject: cs.uid, subjectKind: [l IN labels(cs) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0], value: cond.valueNumber,
            unit: cond.unitCode, statedAs: cond.valueString, qualifiers: cond.qualifiers, validFrom: cond.validFrom} END) AS conditions
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (ass:Assessment {assessmentSubkind: 'D12.claim-threshold-comparison'})-[:ASSESSES]->(p)
WHERE ass.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (ass)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(input:Assertion)
WITH p, lv, c, dc, decl, conditions, ass, collect(DISTINCT input.uid) AS inputs
CALL (decl) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (decl)-[tev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tsnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tsrc:Source)
  WHERE tev.role IN ['SUPPORTS', 'QUALIFIES']
  OPTIONAL MATCH (decl)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(twho)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (tadj:Adjudication {adjudicationKind: 'CAPTURE_FIDELITY'})-[:ASSESSES]->(decl) WHERE tadj.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tloc IS NULL THEN null ELSE
           {assertion: decl.uid, asserter: twho.uid, role: tev.role, selectorKind: tloc.selectorKind, exact: tloc.exact, page: tloc.page,
            contentHash: tsnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tsnap.retrievedAt, source: tsrc.uid, verdict: tadj.verdict} END) AS trace
}
RETURN lv.uid AS labelVersion, c.uid AS declaredMeasurandUid, c.name AS declaredMeasurand,
       dc.amount AS amount, dc.unitCode AS unitCode, dc.amountBasis AS amountBasis,
       [q IN decl.qualifiers WHERE q STARTS WITH 'statement:' | trim(substring(q, 10))][0] AS statementAsPrinted,   // R-30 (was dc.statementVerbatim)
       [q IN decl.qualifiers WHERE q STARTS WITH 'declaredName:' | trim(substring(q, 13))][0] AS declaredAs,
       conditions, ass.uid AS assessment, ass.conclusionCode AS conclusionCode, ass.rationale AS rationale, inputs, trace

corrections.defect: `MATCH ()-[r:MENTIONS|COVERS_LOCATOR|...]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs`: a multi-type anonymous pattern is planned from an all-nodes scan
corrections.fix: one single-type branch per derived relationship type in a UNION ALL subquery (relationship type scan / `rel_<TYPE>_writer` index seek)
corrections.statement:
// @id P-10a.4 derived edges written by the mission's projection runs (S4 correction: per-type branches)
MATCH (act:Activity {missionId: $missionId})
WITH collect(act.runId) AS runs
CALL (runs) {
  MATCH ()-[r:MENTIONS]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:COVERS_LOCATOR]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:AFFECTS_MECHANISM]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:ASSOCIATES]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:RESOLVES_TO_CONSTRAINT]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:STATES_CONSTRAINT]->() WHERE r.lastWriterRunId IN runs RETURN r
}
RETURN r.lastWriterRunId AS runId, type(r) AS relType, count(r) AS edges

corrections.defect: same multi-type anonymous relationship pattern as P-10a.4
corrections.statement:
// @id P-10c.2 derived edges citing M's Assertions (S4 correction: per-type branches)
MATCH (:Activity {missionId: $missionId})<-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]-(a:Assertion)
WITH collect(a.uid) AS outUids
CALL (outUids) {
  MATCH ()-[r:MENTIONS]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:COVERS_LOCATOR]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:AFFECTS_MECHANISM]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:ASSOCIATES]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:RESOLVES_TO_CONSTRAINT]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
  UNION ALL
  MATCH ()-[r:STATES_CONSTRAINT]->() WHERE r.projectionOfAssertionUid IN outUids OR any(u IN coalesce(r.derivedFromAssertionUids, []) WHERE u IN outUids) RETURN r
}
RETURN type(r) AS relType, count(r) AS edges

corrections.defect: `MATCH (x:Subjectable {uid: $xUid})`: Subjectable is a GraphQL interface, never a stored label, so the statement can return no row on a v2 graph
corrections.fix: `MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $xUid})` (Subjectable implementers carry Entity); template status can move from held to supported once fixture rows exist
corrections.statement:
// @id Q-D5-20
MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $xUid})
MATCH (ai:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(x), (ai)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(t:Target)
WHERE ai.predicate IN ['INTENDED_FOR_TARGET', 'IMPROVES_TARGET'] AND ai.recordedTo IS NULL
MATCH (ae:Assertion {predicate: 'CAUSES_ADVERSE_EFFECT'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(x), (ae)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(effect:Condition)
WHERE ae.recordedTo IS NULL
// R-70: Condition is a TargetMeasure member; R-42: no join through a shared Identifier
MATCH (t)-[op:OPERATIONALIZED_BY]->(effect)
WHERE op.recordedTo IS NULL
CALL (ae) {
  // TRACE(ae) + the causality framing: CAUTIONS assertions evidenced on the same snapshot as the report
  OPTIONAL MATCH (ae)-[ev:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(loc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(snap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (adj:Adjudication)-[:ASSESSES]->(ae)
    WHERE adj.recordedAt <= $asOf AND (adj.recordedTo IS NULL OR adj.recordedTo > $asOf)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (ae)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(who)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (ae)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(act:Activity)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (cv:Assertion {speechAct: 'CAUTIONS'})-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(cloc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(snap)
    WHERE cv.recordedTo IS NULL
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT {assertedBy: who.uid, role: ev.role, locator: loc.uid, exact: loc.exact,
                           contentHash: snap.contentHash, retrievedAt: snap.retrievedAt, uri: src.canonicalUri,
                           verdict: adj.verdict, missionId: act.missionId, runId: act.runId}) AS trace,
         collect(DISTINCT {assertion: cv.uid, exact: cloc.exact}) AS causalityCaveats
}
RETURN t.key AS target, ai.predicate AS intendedVia, effect.name AS adverseEffect, op.assertionUid AS measureAssertion,
       ae.valueString AS frequencyOrCount, ae.qualifiers AS qualifiers, ae.uid AS adverseEffectAssertion,
       trace, causalityCaveats

corrections.defect: the hard `*0..4` undirected organization path cannot reach a SELLER_OF_RECORD through MerchantListing -> Offer (5 hops) or a predicate-only maker (R-68)
corrections.fix: replace the `*0..4` path with the final P-09 bounded `behind` set (brand owner, product brand owner, predicate-only maker/distributor/supplier, listing seller of record, the item itself) plus PARENT_OF{0,2}; relationHops becomes the matched `behind` route
corrections.statement:
// @id Q-D9-02
MATCH (p:Person {uid: $personUid})<-[:ASSERTED_BY]-(o:Assertion {assertionKind: 'CLAIM', speechAct: 'RECOMMENDS', predicate: 'RECOMMENDS_USE'})-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(item)
WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:OCCURS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(osnap:SourceSnapshot)
WITH p, o, item, w, min(coalesce(osnap.publishedAt, osnap.observedAt)) AS snapT
WITH p, o, item, w, CASE WHEN w IS NULL THEN snapT ELSE w.publishedAt END AS T
MATCH (p)-[i:HOLDS_ROLE|HOLDS_STAKE|RECEIVES_VALUE_FROM]->(org:Organization)
WHERE i.recordedTo IS NULL
WITH p, o, item, w, T, i, org, COLLECT {
       MATCH (item)-[:BRANDED_AS]->(:Brand)<-[:OWNS_BRAND]-(b:Organization) RETURN {org: b, route: 2} AS hit
       UNION
       MATCH (item)<-[:HAS_VARIANT]-(:Product)-[:BRANDED_AS]->(:Brand)<-[:OWNS_BRAND]-(b:Organization) RETURN {org: b, route: 3} AS hit
       UNION
       MATCH (item)<-[:HAS_OBJECT]-(mf:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(b:Organization)
       WHERE mf.predicate IN ['MANUFACTURES', 'CONTRACT_MANUFACTURES_FOR', 'DISTRIBUTES', 'SUPPLIES_MATERIAL'] AND mf.recordedTo IS NULL
       RETURN {org: b, route: 1} AS hit
       UNION
       MATCH (item)-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:ProductVariant)-[:HAS_PACKAGE]->(:Package)<-[:LISTING_FOR]-(:MerchantListing)-[:HAS_OFFER]->(:Offer)-[:SELLER_OF_RECORD]->(b:Organization)
       RETURN {org: b, route: 5} AS hit
       UNION
       WITH item AS b WHERE b:Organization RETURN {org: b, route: 0} AS hit
     } AS behind
WITH p, o, item, w, T, i, org, [x IN behind WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (org)-[:PARENT_OF]-{0,2}(q:Organization) WHERE q = x.org } | x.route] AS routes
WHERE size(routes) > 0
WITH p, o, item, w, T, i, org, reduce(m = 99, r IN routes | CASE WHEN r < m THEN r ELSE m END) AS relationHops
OPTIONAL MATCH (ia:Assertion {uid: i.assertionUid})
RETURN o.uid AS occurrence, item.uid AS item, item.name, org.uid AS org, org.name, type(i) AS family, i.validFrom, i.validTo, relationHops,
       w.uid AS container, T,
       CASE
      WHEN T IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN CASE WHEN i.validFromPrecision IN ['YEAR', 'MONTH', 'DAY'] AND i.validFrom IS NOT NULL
                THEN datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validFromPrecision), i.validFrom) = datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validFromPrecision), T) ELSE false END
        OR CASE WHEN i.validToPrecision IN ['YEAR', 'MONTH', 'DAY'] AND i.validTo IS NOT NULL
                THEN datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validToPrecision), i.validTo) = datetime.truncate(toLower(i.validToPrecision), T) ELSE false END THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN (i.validTo IS NOT NULL AND i.validTo <= T) OR (i.validFrom IS NOT NULL AND i.validFrom > T) THEN 'DISJOINT'
      WHEN i.validFrom IS NOT NULL AND i.validFrom <= T AND (i.validTo > T OR (i.validTo IS NULL AND ia.validObservedAt >= T)) THEN 'OVERLAPS'
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS temporalOverlap,
       COLLECT { MATCH (dDa:Assertion)-[:HAS_OBJECT]->(org)
      WHERE dDa.recordedTo IS NULL
        AND ((dDa.predicate = type(i) AND EXISTS { (dDa)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(p) })
             OR (dDa.predicate = 'DISCLOSES_INTEREST' AND coalesce(dDa.polarity, 'POSITIVE') <> 'NEGATIVE'
                 AND (EXISTS { (dDa)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(p) } OR EXISTS { (dDa)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(w) })))
      MATCH (dDa)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(dSnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(dSrc:Source)
      WITH dDa, dSrc, coalesce(dSnap.publishedAt, dSnap.observedAt) AS dAt, EXISTS { (dSrc)-[:RENDITION_OF]->(w) } AS dInContainer
      RETURN {disclosure: dDa.uid, predicate: dDa.predicate, at: dAt, source: dSrc.canonicalUri,
              timing: CASE WHEN dAt IS NULL OR T IS NULL THEN 'TIMING_UNKNOWN'
                           WHEN dInContainer AND dAt <= T THEN 'DISCLOSED_IN_CONTAINER'
                           WHEN dInContainer THEN 'DISCLOSED_IN_LATER_REVISION'
                           WHEN dAt <= T THEN 'DISCLOSED_ELSEWHERE_AT_TIME'
                           ELSE 'DISCLOSED_ELSEWHERE' END} } AS disclosures,
       COLLECT { MATCH (cr:Assessment {assessmentKind: 'CONFLICT_RELEVANCE'})-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(o) WHERE cr.recordedTo IS NULL
                 RETURN {assessment: cr.uid, level: cr.conclusionCode, facets: cr.facets} } AS judgments,
       COLLECT { MATCH (o)-[tEv:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tLoc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tSnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tSrc:Source)
      WHERE tEv.role IN ['SUPPORTS', 'QUALIFIES']
      OPTIONAL MATCH (tSrc)-[:RENDITION_OF]->(tRw:MediaWork)
      RETURN {role: tEv.role, selectorKind: tLoc.selectorKind, exact: tLoc.exact, startOffset: tLoc.startOffset, endOffset: tLoc.endOffset,
              mediaStartSeconds: tLoc.mediaStartSeconds, mediaEndSeconds: tLoc.mediaEndSeconds, speakerLabel: tLoc.speakerLabelInSource,
              contentHash: tSnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tSnap.retrievedAt, captureCompleteness: tSnap.captureCompleteness,
              uri: tSrc.canonicalUri, genre: tSrc.genre, renditionOfWork: tRw.uid,
              captureFidelity: COLLECT { MATCH (tAdj:Adjudication {adjudicationKind: 'CAPTURE_FIDELITY'})-[:ASSESSES]->(o) WHERE tAdj.recordedTo IS NULL
                                         RETURN tAdj {.uid, .verdict, .policyOutcome} }} } AS recommendationTrace, COLLECT { MATCH (ia)-[tEv:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(tLoc:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(tSnap:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(tSrc:Source)
      WHERE tEv.role IN ['SUPPORTS', 'QUALIFIES']
      OPTIONAL MATCH (tSrc)-[:RENDITION_OF]->(tRw:MediaWork)
      RETURN {role: tEv.role, selectorKind: tLoc.selectorKind, exact: tLoc.exact, startOffset: tLoc.startOffset, endOffset: tLoc.endOffset,
              mediaStartSeconds: tLoc.mediaStartSeconds, mediaEndSeconds: tLoc.mediaEndSeconds, speakerLabel: tLoc.speakerLabelInSource,
              contentHash: tSnap.contentHash, retrievedAt: tSnap.retrievedAt, captureCompleteness: tSnap.captureCompleteness,
              uri: tSrc.canonicalUri, genre: tSrc.genre, renditionOfWork: tRw.uid,
              captureFidelity: COLLECT { MATCH (tAdj:Adjudication {adjudicationKind: 'CAPTURE_FIDELITY'})-[:ASSESSES]->(ia) WHERE tAdj.recordedTo IS NULL
                                         RETURN tAdj {.uid, .verdict, .policyOutcome} }} } AS interestTrace

proposedTemplates.statement:
MATCH (c:Claim {uid: $claimUid})<-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]-(o:Assertion)
WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:ASSERTED_BY]->(who:Entity)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:OCCURS_IN]->(w:MediaWork)
RETURN o.uid AS occurrence, who.uid AS asserterUid, who.name AS asserter, w.uid AS container, o.speechAct AS speechAct,
  o.basisKind AS basisKind, o.polarity AS polarity, o.status AS status, coalesce(o.validFrom, o.validObservedAt) AS statedAt,
  COLLECT { MATCH (o)-[e:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(l:SourceLocator)<-[:HAS_LOCATOR]-(s:SourceSnapshot)<-[:HAS_SNAPSHOT]-(src:Source)
            RETURN {role: e.role, origin: e.origin, locator: l.uid, selectorDigest: l.selectorDigest, retrievedAt: s.retrievedAt, uri: src.canonicalUri} } AS spans,
  COLLECT { MATCH (v:Assessment {assessmentKind: 'VETTING'})-[:ASSESSES]->(c) WHERE v.recordedTo IS NULL
            RETURN {vetting: v.uid, disposition: v.disposition} } AS vetting
ORDER BY occurrence
proposedTemplates.typedEquivalent: assertion {about: {uid: <subject>, predicate}} filtered by occurrenceOf.uid = claim (spans, asserter, speech act, basis)
proposedTemplates.notes: every current occurrence of claim C with asserter, container, located spans (HAS_EVIDENCE role/origin -> locator -> snapshot -> source), date, speech act, basis and the current VETTING disposition

proposedTemplates.statement:
MATCH (x:Entity {uid: $uid})-[h:HAS_IDENTIFIER]->(i:Identifier)
RETURN i.scheme AS scheme, i.issuer AS issuer, i.value AS value, h.isPrimary AS isPrimary, h.validFrom AS validFrom, h.validTo AS validTo,
  h.recordedFrom AS recordedFrom, h.recordedTo AS recordedTo, h.assertionUid AS authorizedBy
ORDER BY scheme, issuer, value, recordedFrom
proposedTemplates.typedEquivalent: card {uid} -> identifiers (open episodes); resolve {identifiers} for the reverse lookup
proposedTemplates.notes: which identifiers X carries, from which issuer, valid when (all episodes, open and closed)

proposedTemplates.statement:
MATCH (i:Identifier {scheme: $scheme, value: $value})<-[h:HAS_IDENTIFIER]-(x:Entity)
WHERE h.recordedTo IS NULL
RETURN x.uid AS uid, x.name AS name, i.issuer AS issuer, h.isPrimary AS isPrimary, h.assertionUid AS authorizedBy
ORDER BY uid, issuer
proposedTemplates.notes: which entity carries identifier (scheme, value): normalized value; one Identifier identifies at most one record (R-42); several issuers are listed, never merged

proposedTemplates.statement:
MATCH (r:Report {reportKind: 'EVIDENCE_REPORT'})-[:ASSESSES]->(c:Claim)
WHERE r.recordedTo IS NULL AND r.verdict IN ['NOT_SUPPORTED', 'CONTRADICTED']
RETURN c.uid AS claim, c.proposition AS proposition, r.uid AS report, r.verdict AS verdict, r.publishedAt AS publishedAt, r.recordedAt AS reportRecordedAt,
  COLLECT { MATCH (c)<-[:OCCURRENCE_OF]-(o:Assertion) WHERE o.recordedTo IS NULL AND coalesce(o.validFrom, o.validObservedAt, o.recordedAt) > coalesce(r.publishedAt, r.recordedAt)
            RETURN o.uid } AS repeatedSince
ORDER BY claim, report
LIMIT 100
proposedTemplates.notes: claims an evidence mission reported NOT_SUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED, and the occurrences stated (or, without a stated date, recorded) after the report
